Oxcarbazepine has been tried in the prophylaxis and treatment of various with- drawal syndromes. Although it was not found1 to be superior to placebo in the treatment of symptoms of the alcohol withdrawal syndrome (p.1626), oxcarbazepine has been reported2-4 to be of benefit in relapse prevention; further studies are considered war- ranted. It has also been tried5 during benzodiazepine withdrawal but such adjunct therapy is not usually indicated (see p.987). 1. Koethe D, et al.
